verdict.rationale: Pigment publishes a dedicated, first-party MCP server page. It says users can build and edit Pigment models from Claude, Cursor, and Codex, and query business data from ChatGPT or Claude, with sessions authenticated through enterprise identity and admin approval of which assistants connect. A probe also confirms the official MCP server is documented. Missing for 10: technical setup documentation (endpoint URL, transport, tool list), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Build and edit your Pigment model directly from tools like Claude, Cursor, and Codex, without switching interfaces.
teams can ask questions of the business in ChatGPT or Claude and get accurate answers grounded in your business truth.
Every session is authenticated through enterprise identity, and access is scoped by role, model, or metric. Admins approve which assistants connect
official MCP server documented at https://www.pigment.com/ai/mcp-server
